rules.pattern: warning: Some design elements have no explicit time unit and/or
rules.reason: Several existing RTL modules do not declare a timescale. RTL testbenches define timing units explicitly; Verilator and synthesis checks are separate evidence, and no timing claim is derived from this simulation.

rules.pattern: warning: System task \(\$fatal\) cannot be synthesized in an always_(?:comb|ff) process
rules.reason: Simulation-only invariant checks intentionally use $fatal under `ifndef SYNTHESIS. They are excluded from synthesis; synthesis smoke validates the synthesizable branch separately.

rules.pattern: sorry: constant selects in always_\* processes are not currently supported
rules.reason: Icarus conservatively includes all bits in the inferred sensitivity set for constant selects in always_* processes. This is an elaboration/sensitivity limitation, not a simulation result promotion.

rules.pattern: sorry: Case unique/unique0 qualities are ignored
rules.reason: Icarus ignores unique-case runtime qualities. Directed tests exercise legal encodings; the RTL lint/synthesis lane provides an independent parser/elaboration check.

rules.pattern: warning: @\* is sensitive to all [0-9]+ words in array '[^']+'
rules.reason: Icarus includes every unpacked array element in an @* sensitivity list. This reports conservative simulation sensitivity and does not change the combinational function.
